question: A person who spends 36(2)/(3)\% of his monthly income is able to save Rs. 5,700 per month. His monthly expenses are:
solution:
**Given:**

A person who spends 36(2)/(3)\% of his monthly income is able to save Rs. 5,700 per month

**Calculation:**

(100% - 36(2)/(3)\% ) of Income = 5,700

⇒ (190)/(3)%% of income = 5,700

⇒ 1% of income = 5,700 × (300)/(190)

⇒ 36(2)/(3)\% of income = 9000 × (110)/(300) = 3,300

**Hence, The Required value is Rs.3300.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Here, 36(2)/(3)\% = 20% + 16(2)/(3)\% = 1/5 + 1/6 = 11/30 

So, the Ratio of Expenditure to income = 11 : 30

Then, saving = 30 - 11 = 19 units

⇒ 19 units = 5700

⇒ Expenditure = 11 units = (5700/19) × 11 = Rs.3,300
